name: Boyd Corporation
description: Thermal-management and engineered-materials company. Its thermal business was sold to Eaton for $9.5 billion (announced November 2025, completed March 2026); Boyd Corporation continues separately with sealing, protection and EMI/RFI products.
products: EMI/RFI shielding for AI data centres
notes: The card cites Boyd for liquid-cooling loops and cold plates, but no Boyd page read on 2026-11-16 mentions cold plates, CDUs or coolant loops - its data-centre content is EMI/RFI shielding. The thermal business now sits with Eaton, and Eaton's thermal pages timed out. Treat the cold-plate attribution as unconfirmed until Eaton's product pages are read.
